prompt: Blue brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Toy Box Fun
hook: Toy box fun, toy box fun!
irony: Blue hauls the biggest toy box home to gather every toy inside, but the kids pour the toys back onto the street to share, so the whole street turns into one big toy box.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blue drags the biggest toy box up the big house steps while Green and Navy gape at its huge flaps.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants to count every toy into the toy box and corrects Blue, too scared to climb inside unread.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black struts in and bets they cannot fill the toy box with every toy on the street by supper.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole gang circles the huge toy box on the steps and sings the big toy box hook together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: They wheel the toy box to the street and stack toys high until the pile topples onto Green.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade yells hold my juice, dives into the toy box, and Navy piles in after with toys flying everywhere.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Half buried in toys inside the toy box on the street, the kids shout the hook again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue watches the spilled toys glow under street lamps and owns buying big instead of playing close.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue decides to give the toys to the street and keeps the empty toy box for playing together inside.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Back around the empty toy box, the gang sings the hook while Blue turns the last line to the street.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They sing the hook by the toy box on the big house steps and share toys across glowing porches.
